name: FeCoSplat
aliases: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A two-stage feature compression framework for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that decouples compression into multi-view feature coding and reconstruction-conditioned feedback coding, allowing the receiver to decode directly in the compact feature-state domain without reconstructing intermediate Gaussians.
summary: FeCoSplat is a two-stage feature compression framework for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses rendered feedback to guide refinement, enabling direct decoding in the compact feature-state domain.
